The '''Morturia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="New Territories" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Morturian energy disk]] weapon.<ref name="Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Morturian energy disk]]|system=Morturia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Morturia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square L-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
